gen-gf-revalia-gf-chocolate-classical-sa: Loud, loose and a bit theatrical, Revalia spreads its wide-set letters out like it owns the room. And Chocolate Classical Sans keeps to a plain sans job, with a broad-nibbed pen stroke and a sizable lowercase that simply gets on with the words.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-comme: Expressive and unbothered, Revalia sprawls across the line. Comme answers with smooth, unclogged curves and lowercase bodies filling most of the letter height, while Revalia earns its keep when big and brief.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-cossette-texte: Cossette Texte reads wide-eyed and open, with a prominent x-height and arches as sturdy as the stems beside them. And Revalia's relaxed, widely spaced stride against that plain sans is the pair's best trick, loud swagger over quiet clarity.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-duru-sans: Brash up top, hushed below. Revalia's open-curved g and loose stride grab attention, while Duru Sans lets its wide-open small letters dominate the line with ascenders that barely announce themselves.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-funnel-sans: Showy meets sensible here. Revalia swaggers with its open-bottomed g and widely separated letters, and Funnel Sans, a plain sans with a pried-open e and strokes that never waver, is what makes that swagger feel grounded.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-gafata: Revalia is the loud one, with a g that never closes. Its tall letter band and relaxed spacing make a statement, while Gafata, a sans-serif with wide-eyed lowercase e shapes, quietly does the everyday work.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-geist: Expressive is the right word for Revalia, whose open-tailed g and loose stride lean toward showmanship. Geist, a plain sans, settles into a level beat with no accents of weight, so words come across as solid blocks.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-gidole: Revalia's g leaves its lower curve wide open. Gidole, a plain sans with neon-tube consistency and a high-set midline, makes the strongest quality of the pair its contrast: showy letters over strokes that never change.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-hedvig-letters-sans: Hedvig Letters Sans reads friendly and direct, with a clear gap where the c ends and small letters nearly as tall as capitals. And Revalia sits beside it like a show-off next to a good listener, bold and loose against a sans that feels approachable.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-heebo: Bold, with a relaxed stride, Revalia takes the stage on widely separated letters and an open-curved g. And Heebo fills in behind it, its tall central band and curves that stop short giving the page a steady sans to lean on.
